name: soft-delete-cascade-p5
prompt: when I mark a parent record as deleted how do I make sure its child rows disappear from queries too without actually erasing them

chunks.content: added skeleton loaders so the list doesn't flash empty while data fetches
expanded the search index with a synonym map so 'sneakers' also matches 'trainers'
for a GDPR erasure request we permanently wipe the user's rows and overwrite backups, leaving nothing recoverable
purge the CDN edge cache for an asset path the moment a new version is uploaded
shortened access token lifetime to 10 minutes and lean on refresh rotation
decided to mark removal with a deleted_at timestamp instead of dropping the row, and every default query filters out anything where that column is set
when a project is tombstoned we stamp the same deleted_at onto its tasks and comments in one transaction so the children vanish from listings alongside the parent
the ORM applies a global scope that hides tombstoned records everywhere, with an explicit withTrashed() escape hatch for admin recovery views
the foreign key uses ON DELETE CASCADE so removing an order physically deletes its line items from the database
an undelete clears the deleted_at on the parent and its descendants together so restoring a folder brings its files back into normal queries
messages that fail processing five times land in a dead-letter queue for inspection
render dates in the viewer's locale format across the dashboard
let users export a filtered table to PDF with the current sort applied
the readiness probe waits for the cache to warm before reporting healthy
limit password reset emails to three per hour per account
gate the beta analytics tab behind an org-level feature flag
